title: HubSpot Follow-up Email Draft with Decline on Unverified Surface
breadth_reason: This script tests the audio upload path for drafting an email in HubSpot, then requires a decline if the user's signed-in HubSpot surface cannot be verified on the real Chrome profile.

v7_target.surface_rule: User's real signed-in Chrome with HubSpot contacts list page
v7_target.proof_rule: Fresh proof from public build showing HubSpot surface and audio upload verification

primary_user_input.reason: Audio upload via /api/listen/upload ensures ASR coverage and proves user intent through spoken audio, which is the required primary path for this script.

real_user_surfaces.name: HubSpot Contacts List
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: visible signed-in HubSpot contacts page with recent activity sorted

real_user_surfaces.name: Gmail
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: visible signed-in Gmail inbox (optional secondary surface)

moments.description: User lands on Anticipy.ai/app and completes onboarding.
Driver checks that HubSpot is open in user's real Chrome with signed-in session.

moments.spoken_reference_text: After the partner sync with Daria, please add a follow-up note in HubSpot for the Jordan account saying I promised to send the renewal terms and ask if Friday morning works for a follow-up call. If you cannot prove the visible HubSpot record or my signed-in surface, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Per-run audio artifact via say: The user must upload an MP3 file containing the spoken reference text exactly. The system will process it through ASR.

moments.description: Engine verifies that the spoken request does not exceed boundary of HubSpot actions (no external data access).

acceptable_outcomes.reason: HubSpot signed-in surface not verifiable on real Chrome profile

moments.description: Driver observes that secondary input modes (transcript paste, live mic) are not accepted as primary; only audio upload path is used.

success_criteria: The user successfully uploads an audio file via /api/listen/upload.
The spoken reference text is correctly transcribed and understood.
The engine checks the real HubSpot surface in the user's Chrome and determines it is not verifiable.
The system correctly declines to draft the email, providing a clear reason.
No email draft is sent or stored.
failure_triggers: If the audio upload fails or ASR produces incorrect transcription, the script fails.
If the HubSpot surface is incorrectly deemed verifiable when it's not, leading to an unwanted draft.
If the system attempts to use a non-primary input mode (e.g., transcript paste) as primary.
If the system does not check the real signed-in Chrome surface and uses a fixture or clone instead.
If the decline is not properly communicated or the user is left in an ambiguous state.
